suggestions.quote: A hundred and sixty teams once got thousands of facts about thousands of families, to predict how the children's lives would turn out. The best predictions were only slightly better than a simple guess from four facts (c24).

keep.quote: Drivers tracked by their insurer for a discount braked hard about a fifth less often within six months (c17). The watching changed the driving.

In 2008 (c04), brain scans could guess whether a person would press a left or a right button a few seconds before they felt they'd chosen (c04). The guess was right about sixty times in a hundred (c05). A coin gets fifty.
When scientists watched people choose where real charity money would go, the famous early brain signal was missing (c06).
